idh.reasoning: The patient is 77 years old, which is advanced age favoring IDH-wildtype glioma. The tumor is midline, solitary, with ependymal invasion, deep white matter invasion, marked enhancement, and crosses midline - features typical of IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. Proportion necrosis (9.6%) and proportion enhancing (26.3%) are consistent with high-grade glioma.

one_p_nineteen_q.reasoning: IDH-wildtype gliomas are typically 1p/19q non-codeleted. The midline location and ependymal invasion are uncommon in oligodendrogliomas which require 1p/19q codeletion. Frontal lobe location alone is insufficient to suggest codeletion without IDH mutation.

overall_comment: High-grade glioma features dominate: advanced age, midline location, ependymal invasion, marked enhancement. Confidence in IDH-wildtype is high due to classic presentation. Grade 4 assigned based on necrosis and enhancement.

who_grade.reasoning: Presence of necrosis (9.6%) and marked enhancement with thick margin (>3mm) indicate WHO grade 4. Ependymal invasion and eloquent area involvement further support high-grade designation. Total tumor volume (165.9mL) is large but not definitive.
